name: Reverend Mother Mohiam
text:
Opponents play with their hands revealed.
[When Played:] Discard any number of [{Bene Gesserit}] cards from your hand. For each card discarded this way, choose a card in each opponent's hand. They discard it.
subtitle: The Emperor's Truthsayer
